overview: TradeNest Naturals is an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter offering dehydrated Kapoor Kachri Powder derived from Indian ginger lily roots. We follow a controlled 6-step manufacturing process covering careful sourcing, cleaning, sorting, drying, grinding, and sieving. This hygienic processing ensures consistent 80 to 100 mesh sizing and uniform aroma. We deliver reliable botanical ingredients for global production runs.

Our dehydrated powder maintains a moisture level below 10 percent and offers a 24-month shelf life. As a dedicated wholesale partner, TradeNest Naturals supports international buyers with bulk supplies, custom grinding specifications, private labeling, and complete export documentation. With a manageable 5 Kg minimum order quantity, we support scalable commercial manufacturing across global personal care and herbal markets.
highlights: Processed from selected Indian ginger lily roots
Uniform fine powder of 80 to 100 mesh
Controlled dehydration with moisture level under 10 percent
Indian origin verified under HS Code 12119099

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for Kapoor Kachri Powder?
faqs.a: The minimum order quantity is 5 Kg, accommodating both pilot formulation testing and bulk commercial orders.

faqs.q: What mesh sizes and processing specifications do you provide?
faqs.a: Standard production delivers an 80 to 100 mesh dehydrated powder, with custom mesh sizing available upon request.

faqs.q: What packaging configurations are available for bulk and retail orders?
faqs.a: We supply 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5 to 10 kg bags, as well as customized private-label pouches and jars.

faqs.q: Can TradeNest Naturals assist with export documentation?
faqs.a: Yes, as an IEC-registered exporter, we provide export documentation support and batch traceability for international shipments.

faqs.q: What is the recommended storage and shelf life of the powder?
faqs.a: The product retains a 24-month shelf life when stored in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and moisture.

faqs.q: Are product samples available prior to commercial ordering?
faqs.a: Yes, TradeNest Naturals provides product samples on request to assist with formulation evaluation and technical review.
